replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a statistical technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. The first principal component captures the most variance in the data, the second captures the second most, and so on. To perform PCA, first, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Next, compute the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. Sort the eigenvalues in descending order and choose the top k eigenvalues. The corresponding eigenvectors form the principal components. Project the data onto the principal components.
